component.name: GifDeck
component.summary: Animated GIF and PNG widgets for your desktop

description.p: GifDeck puts animated GIFs and PNG images on your desktop as independent widgets, all managed from one small window and one background process.

ul.li: Per-widget layers: normal, always on top, or pinned behind your windows
Borderless transparent widgets, or standard window decorations
Reorder widgets to set which one is in front
Presets, assignable to days of the week or times of day
Works on X11 and on Wayland compositors with layer-shell, such as COSMIC

description.p: Rotate widgets and masks, transform masks on screen, animated GIF masks, mask opacity, one-command native install.
